ITA.scope: Italian general government (State, social security institutions and local authorities, consolidated), 1990; 1,198.1 lire per US$. Rates approximate; tax split within groups estimated.

mechs.name: Personal income tax (IRPEF)
mechs.note: IRPEF, 1990 net State tax of 56.7 bn euro. 1990 scale: 7 bands from 10% up to 50% above about 318 million lire; bands shown in US$, approximate.

mechs.name: Corporate income tax (IRPEG)
mechs.note: IRPEG at 36% on company profits. Split of direct taxes other than IRPEF is estimated from January-September 1990 State receipts.

mechs.name: Local income tax (ILOR)
mechs.note: ILOR, 16.2% on business, self-employed and property income. Estimated share of direct taxes.

mechs.name: Substitute tax on interest income
mechs.note: Withholding on interest from bank deposits and government bonds. Estimated share of direct taxes.

mechs.name: Withholding on dividends and other direct taxes
mechs.note: Tax withheld on distributed profits plus small direct taxes. Estimated share.

mechs.name: Value-added tax (IVA)
mechs.note: IVA, standard rate 19% in 1990, reduced 9% and 4%, 38% on luxuries. Estimated share of indirect taxes.

mechs.name: Mineral oil excise
mechs.note: Excise on petrol, diesel and heating oil; raised in 1990. Estimated share of indirect taxes.

mechs.name: Tobacco and other consumption taxes
mechs.note: Tobacco consumption tax and other manufacturing and consumption duties. Estimated share.

mechs.name: Taxes on transactions
mechs.note: Registration, mortgage, stamp and insurance duties and other taxes on transactions. Estimated share.

mechs.name: Lotto, lotteries and other indirect taxes
mechs.note: Lotto, lotteries and small indirect taxes. Estimated share.

mechs.name: Social security contributions
mechs.note: Employer and employee contributions to INPS, INAIL and other funds, actual and imputed, 1990 (Table 14).

mechs.name: Other current revenue
mechs.note: Property income, sales of goods and services, fees, EC grants and other current receipts (Table 14).

mechs.name: Capital revenue
mechs.note: Capital taxes and capital transfers received (Table 14).
